Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this lopsided contest. On Wednesday, 9th March 2022, it's going to be a big clash between West Indies Women and England Women. The first ball will be at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous day) but you can join us in advance for the coverage. Cheers!

Meg Lanning, the winning captain of Australia Women, says that she is happy with the performance and how they adapted to spin-friendly conditions. Mentions they would love to take 10 wickets as that slows down the run rate. Shares that they like this venue and the beach is nearby, and they would love to play more cricket here. Mentions that everyone is looking in good touch and she is glad about Healy's innings. Tells that they always try to make sure that someone in the top order scores big and they are looking forward to the next match against New Zealand.

Bismah Maroof, the captain of Pakistan Women, says that they lost too many wickets early on. Feels that they had a decent total after the kind of start they had. Adds that they could have done better in the field. She counts her partnership with Aliya Riaz as a positive. On her own performance, she replies it was very important for her to perform and she wanted to make it count. Tells that they need to believe that they can win and put up a good total for the bowlers to defend.

Alyssa Healy (72) is the Player of the Match! Says that it's nice to get a win, she didn't feel particularly well out there but is happy with the win. She adds that it's the third game on this wicket and they knew exactly how it was going to play. Praises the curators who have done a great job and now they are looking forward to Wellington. About her injury, Healy replies that it's just a niggle and she is feeling fine. Mentions that she will play a bit of golf in the break and will watch the other matches on TV.
Presentation time...

An excellent outing for Australia Women. It was a nervy win for them last time but this match will offer them and their bowling group some much-needed confidence. Also, the way their batters handled the Pakistan spinners was exceptional. All in all, it's the best possible start to this campaign for the Aussies and they are comfortably placed on the table.

Two games and two thumping defeats! Pakistan Women are finding it tough against better teams at the moment. Against India Women, they at least put up a fight with the ball but in this match, they were beaten comprehensively in all the departments of the game. Apart from the knocks of Bismah Maroof and Aliya Riaz, there was nothing in their batting and their bowling, as mentioned earlier, was quite flat and inconsistent. Omaima Sohail, the part-timer, was the most impressive bowler, getting her off spinners to grip and turn as she grabbed a couple of wickets.

A stroll in the park for Australia Women! They have made a complete mockery of the target in front by overhauling it with 92 balls to spare and registered their 13th consecutive win over Pakistan Women in ODIs. It was expected to be a fierce battle between the Pakistan Women spinners and the Aussie batters but it turned out to be a damp squib. They were far too short with their lengths and got played out very easily. Rachael Haynes laid the foundation with her quickfire knock while Alyssa Healy paced her innings quite smartly. Her stands with Haynes and Meg Lanning put the chase to bed fairly early and then the remaining work was done towards the end by Ellyse Perry and Beth Mooney.

FOUR! A classy shot from Beth Mooney to seal the win for Australia Women. Flighted, around off. Mooney skips down the track, leans in and drives it beautifully through the gap at covers for a boundary. Australia Women win by 7 wickets!
Full, around off and stroked away to the cover region, not in the gap.
Tossed up on middle. Mooney steps out but only manages to push it back to the bowler.
Sliding into middle and leg, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
On a length, turning in sharply from outside off. Perry hops back and dabs it down to short third man.
The keeper seems interested but that's all. Drifting onto the pads, Beth Mooney tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Around middle and leg, flicked away to mid-wicket.
Full and around off, this is nicely driven but straight to cover.
FOUR! Tossed up, around off. Beth Mooney reaches out and lofts it over wide mid on with utmost ease and picks up a boundary. Just 3 needed now.
Flatter delivery, turning into off. Perry pushes it out on the off side for a single.
Peach! Dream delivery from Nida Dar. This is drifting on middle, Mooney gets right behind the line of the ball to block but the ball grips and spins away leaving Mooney beaten all ends up.
Down the leg side, Perry looks to sweep but gets a top edge on it which runs away fine. The keeper gives chase and the batters are able to come back for the third run with ease.
Flatter, close to the off pole and this is cut late towards short third man.

FOUR! Diana Baig has been a livewire in the field today but lets this one through. Dragged down, on off. Ellyse Perry rocks back and muscles it back past the bowler. Baig runs around from long on but can't stop the boundary.
Floated up, around off. Perry pushes it towards cover.
Flighted, very full and on off. Perry jams it out towards the bowler.
Looped up, on off. Perry uses her feet to ease it down to long on for one more. Just 15 required now.
Shorter, around off. Perry looks to punch it off the back foot but can't get it through the cover region.
Quicker one, fired onto the pads. Mooney knocks it 'round the corner for one.
Nicely flighted, around off. Beth Mooney skips down the track and strokes it through covers for a brace.
On off, this is driven down to long on for a run.
Shorter and wider, Ellyse Perry rocks back and cuts it past the diving fielder at cover for a couple of runs.
Nida drops it short and wide outside off, Perry camps back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single. 22 needed more.
Allows the ball to spin away from herself and taps it gently towards backward point for a single.
Tossed up, around leg and turning down, Ellyse Perry goes back and works it through square leg for a single.
Loopy and full, around leg, Mooney sweeps it behind square leg for a run.
Slightly short and on off, spinning away, Beth gets back but mistimes her square cut.
Turn and grip, around off, Mooney gets back to push inside the line but misses.
Nida Dar to bowl again.
Uppish but in the gap! Outside off, Mooney cuts it through cover-point and they race back for the third as well. Excellent running!
Beaten all ends up! This is flighted, on the leg stump. The ball hits a crack and just turns away square. Mooney presses forward to block but has no idea what happened there.
Very full, on middle. Ellyse Perry drills it back past the bowler for one more.
Drifting onto the pads, swept away through square leg for a single.
Around middle and leg, tucked away to mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, on a length and on middle. Mooney gets an inside edge on the leg side.
This is full and on off. Mooney drives it down towards long on for another single. Just 31 needed now off 21 overs!
On off, Mooney nudges it out on the off side.
A little fumble from Aliya Riaz and they sneak in the second run. Full toss, around off. Beth Mooney punches it towards wide long on and picks up a couple of runs.
Shorter, around off. Perry goes on the back foot and taps it through cover-point for a run.
Floated up, full and on off. Perry strikes it towards covers.
On off, pushed down to long on for a single.
On middle, Mooney gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it down to fine leg for a single.
Really slow through the air, drifting into middle and leg. Mooney pushes it towards mid on.

Shout for a run out! Turned down by the square leg umpire. Short and outside off, Ellyse Perry plays it in front of short third man and they steal a quick run. The throw comes to the keeper who knocks the stumps off and appeals. Nothing doing.
Tossed up, around off. Perry leans forward to make the block.
Outside off, this is cut away towards the point region.
Beth Mooney walks in next at number 5.

OUT! TAKEN! The dangerous Alyssa Healy departs but maybe it's a bit too late for Pakistan Women. Tossed up, on a length and around off. Healy skips down the track but doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball this time. She tries to force it over the long on fence but the ball comes off the toe end of the bat. Nashra Sandhu comes in from the long on fence and takes a good catch. Omaima Sohail gets yet another wicket. 38 needed now off 137 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Nashra Sandhu b Omaima Sohail

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye! Spilled down the leg side, Healy looks to paddle it fine but the ball goes off the pads. The fielder from short fine leg gets to it and the batters get a leg bye.
This is pushed through quicker on middle and leg. Healy flicks it towards square leg.
Flatter, on off. Healy stays back and dabs it down towards backward point.
Half an appeal! This is fired into middle and leg, the ball slides on with the angle. Healy looks to block but gets hit on the pads.
Make that two more! Around off, Healy uses her feet again and lofts it over mid off for a couple.
This is tossed up, on off. Healy steps out and heaves it between deep mid-wicket and long on. Diana Baig speeds across from long on and cuts it off. Two taken.
Flatter this time, well outside off. Ellyse Perry looks for the cut off the back foot but edges it down to short third man.
Fullish delivery, on off. Perry strokes it towards cover.
Outside off, Alyssa Healy drags it down to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Loopy delivery, well outside off. Perry goes for a booming cover-drive but gets an outside edge past short third man for another single.
On off, pushed through covers for a single.
Just over! This is tossed up, on middle. Alyssa Healy comes down the track, converts it into a full toss and just clears Anam Amin at mid-wicket. They pick up an easy two in the end.
WIDE! This is pushed well outside off, Healy misses the cut. Wide called.
Cheeky now. Floated and around off, Healy taps it down with gentle hands to covers and retains strike with a run. Under 50 needed now.
FOUR! Wow, great footwork! Loopy and full, around off, Alyssa Healy is down the track in a flash as she lofts it nonchalantly over extra cover for a boundary.
Fires it full and on middle, Healy shimmies down the track and whips it to wide long on for a couple of runs.
Short again, outside off, Alyssa gets back and cuts it to point. Not in the gap.
Width outside off, cut through cover-point for a run.
Flatter and on middle, Perry defends it by going on the back foot.
Short and down the leg side, Ellyse Perry bends her back knee and pulls it behind square leg for a single. 57 needed more.
Floated and wide outside off, left alone.
Flighted one, a low full toss on off, Healy dances down the track and whips it to mid-wicket. The fielder fumbles and deflects it down to long on. They cross.
Short and wide outside off, stroked from the back foot to sweeper cover for one.
Fuller and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Healy looks to give the charge but then holds herself back as she cuts it to point.
Flighted and on off, a touch on the shorter side, Ellyse punches it from the back foot to covers.
FOUR! Finds the gap and the boundary. Short and wide outside off, Ellyse Perry camps back and plays a full-blooded square cut through the gap at point.
Shortish and on off, Perry goes back and pushes it to covers.
Floated and full around off, again Healy skips down the track and this time she drives it through covers for one.
Tossed up, around off, Healy uses her feet and forces it through the line. Finds the cover fielder.
Flighted and around off, Healy leans and defends it near her front pad.
Anam Amin (4-0-18-0) is back on.
Flighted and full on middle, Alyssa Healy steps down the track and eases it to long on for a single.
Tossed up and outside off, Alyssa tries to play late but it takes the bottom part and drops in front of the keeper.
Knocks it down to long on and Ellyse Perry opens her account.
Short and wide outside off, cut to point where the fielder makes a stop with a dive.
Floated and full, landing outside off, Perry allows it through and the keeper collects it near the off pole.
Ellyse Perry is the new batter in for Australia Women.

OUT! TIMBER! Indecision from Meg Lanning and she loses her stumps. Omaima Sohail puts a lot of revolution on this ball, plenty of energy behind this delivery, it lands outside off and breaks back in sharply. Meg is caught on the back foot, clueless, tries to cut at the last moment but it's too late. It has gone through to destroy the stumps. A wicket against the run of play for Pakistan Women. Can this spark a comeback?
Slower one, short in length, Healy camps back, fetches it from outside off and pulls it in the acres of space at deep mid-wicket. Easy two. 68 needed more.
On a length and close to off, Meg Lanning plays late and guides it down to third man for a run.
Short in length and outside off, but it's on the slower side, Alyssa plays late and cuts it off the outer half. The ball rolls wide of backward point and they cross.
Around off, on a length, Meg taps it down to cover-point and steals a single.

FOUR! The fielder could have done better in the deep. Poor delivery to start with, short and wide outside off, Meg Lanning whacks it behind backward point. Anam Amin rushes across to her right from third man but dives over the ball and lets it through to the fence.
FIFTY FOR HEALY! Short in length and around off, Alyssa Healy goes back and pulls it down to long on for a run. Brings her second fifty in the 50-over World Cup - both coming against Pakistan Women!
Change in bowling. Diana Baig returns for her second spell. 0/25 off her 3 overs so far.

FOUR! Nicely played, deft touch from Meg Lanning. Outside off, Lanning waits for it and cuts it late, past Diana Baig at short third man. Baig gives the chase but just can't keep it in as her fingers touch the ropes whilst the ball in contact as well. Another boundary for Meg and the 50 partnership comes up between these two.
Short and wide, slapped away to sweeper cover for one.
Very full, on off. Healy toe-ends a low full toss towards mid-wicket.
Around off, Lanning steps down the tack and thumps it right back over the bowler's head for just a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Healy stays in her crease and looks to go big downtown but mistimes it badly towards long on. They do get a single.
This is floated up, fuller and on off. Healy makes a bit of room and drives it straight to mid off.
Change! Omaima Sohail to bowl her part-time offies.
On off, pushed towards covers.
FOUR! Slapped away! Touch shorter again, Meg Lanning rocks onto the back foot and pierces the gap between point and cover-point with perfection. The ball races away to the fence.
A bit shorter and wider, Healy hangs back and cuts it through covers for a single.
Around off, this is nudged towards cover-point.
Flatter this time, close to the off pole. Healy taps it towards covers.
Drifted into middle and leg, Healy strides out to defend.
This is nicely flighted, around off. Lanning blocks this one as well.
Slowed up significantly, on a length and around off. Meg watchfully keeps it out.
Slower and shorter, there to be hit. Healy cuts it hard but the fielder at cover does well to get down low to her right and make a half-stop. Just a single then.
Tossed up, on middle. Healy steps out and heaves it towards wide long on for a couple of runs. The 100 is up for Australia Women!
Can Nida Dar do any magic in her second spell?
Flighted, on off. Healy decides to block this one.
FOUR! Cheeky and skilful from Alyssa Healy. Healy shuffles across and steps forward as well. She gets inside the line of the low full toss and laps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Nicely bowled! Fuller and drifted into off. Lanning defends it out.
FOUR! Just a touch short in length and Meg latches onto it in a flash. This is around middle, Meg goes on the back foot and powers it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Less than 100 required now!
Shorter in length, this is hit through covers for a run.
Sandhu pushes it wider and the ball keeps a tad low. Meg Lanning rocks back and slaps it to sweeper cover for one more.
A touch slower through the air, around off. Healy pushes it out towards cover-point and races through for a quick single.
Flatter delivery, on off. Healy cuts it straight to the fielder at point.

Drinks break. Australia Women are cruising here. They have made a strong start and nullified the threat of the Pakistan Women spinners quite easily. Sloppy catching has not helped the Asian team here. They have dropped as many as three catches so far and although Rachael Haynes eventually got out, her knock provided Australia Women with the momentum. Alyssa Healy was also dropped once and she is continuing on her merry way. Only 104 more to get and it appears to be one-way traffic from here onward.
And again! A bit short and wide, cut away hard and to the right of deep point for an easy two. 13 off the over, a big one for Australia Women.
A bit of width on offer and this is slashed away off the back foot, behind point. Diana Baig does well to run around from third man and keep it down to a brace.
FOUR! What a good-looking shot that is! A length ball, around off and this is punched on the up, through the cover-point region for a glorious boundary.

FOUR! Meg Lanning was being bogged down for quite a while now and she finally decides to break the shackles. This is short again, on the body. Meg goes deep in her crease and lofts it over mid on. The ball trickles away into the fence.
Short again, pulled comfortably through mid-wicket for a single by Alyssa Healy.
On the charge, goes Healy, and Fatima drags it down well short and it's slower as well. Healy is through the pull early and gets a bottom edge that doesn't carry to the keeper.
Flatter again, around off, Meg Lanning once again moves back and punches it to point.
Flatter and around off, Meg gets back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Drags her length short and delivers it on off, Lanning punches but finds the cover fielder.
Short and on off, Alyssa goes back and pushes it to covers for a single.
FOUR! This is signature Alyssa Healy! Floated and full, drifting in around middle, Healy wears her skates and smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
Walks down the track to a full ball and forces it towards mid off for a run. Aliya Riaz comes up with a direct hit at the bowler's end but Meg Lanning is safe.
Fuller and on middle, Meg Lanning inside-edges her attempted flick down to deep backward square leg for a run.
Width on offer, outside off, short in length, Meg gets back to cut but ends up chopping it down off the bottom edge to point.
Pitches it up and around off, Meg presses forward and drives it to covers.
Uses the angle of the bowler and defends a length ball to short mid-wicket.
Almost a return catch! Short again, around off, Meg pushes at it a bit early and chips it in the air. It goes wide of the bowler and rolls to mid off.
A touch short and on off, angling in, it's forced off the back foot to covers by Meg.
Loopy and full around off, Alyssa Healy draws forward and defends it gently on the surface.
Short and around off, Meg Lanning goes back and punches it to covers. She steals a quick run to open her account and it could have been close in case of a better throw to the bowler.
This one is pushed quicker through the air, around off and skidding in, Lanning is forward in defense.
Slow turn away from the batter, after landing on off, Meg defends it from the back foot.
Short and around off, Healy gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up, on middle, an arm ball, Healy defends it from the inner half of the bat.
Back of a length, around middle, Meg gets behind the line and eases it towards mid on. The Pakistan Women seamers have been too short with their lengths.
On a length, around off and angling in, Lanning allows it to come to her and pushes it defensively to covers.
Fractionally short and around off, Meg stands back and punches it to cover-point.
Angling in from around off, on a length, Lanning works it to mid-wicket.
Shortish and outside off, steered through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Boom! Short in length, around off and angling in, Alyssa Healy steps down the track and clobbers it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter and on off, blocked on the off side. A terrific first over by Nashra Sandhu.
'CATCH IT'...falls short! Very lazy from Meg. Loopy and full, wide outside off, Meg Lanning chases and slices it towards point. The fielder runs forward but it falls in front of her.
Flighted and outside off, defended off the front foot to covers.
The Australian skipper, Meg Lanning is in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pakistan Women have held on to the catch, at last. A quick check for the front foot no ball but Nashra is fine with her landing, by just. A flighted delivery, full and around middle, Rachael Haynes hurries down the track for a big shot but gets too close to the line. She is not entirely to the pitch of the ball but still goes on with her attempted whip over the leg side. Ends up hitting it flat and aerially to Bismah Maroof at mid-wicket who makes no mistake. A quickfire knock from Rachael Haynes is over!
Commentary.Howout: c Bismah Maroof b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off, turning away, Healy cuts it to deep point for a single.
Flatter and around leg, defended towards mid-wicket.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over, if the match lasts till then. Nashra Sandhu to bowl now...
Length again, slanting across off. Haynes hangs back and punches it towards point. At the end of Powerplay 1, Australia Women are 59/0! A really good start for them.
After being hit for a boundary off her very first delivery, Fatima has been much better with her lengths. On off, Haynes defends it off the front foot.
Drop and run! Around the top of off, Healy bunts it out on the off side for a quick single.
Length again, outside off. Healy taps it towards point.
A length ball, on middle and this is driven towards mid on.

FOUR! Anything short has been punished in this innings! Fatima comes into the attack and just delivers it a touch short on off, Alyssa Healy stands tall and absolutely powers it well in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Fatima Sana is ready to bowl.
A loopy delivery, around middle. Haynes leans in and makes the block.
Rachael Haynes seems disappointed having missed out on that one. Short and wide, took an eternity to reach the batter. Haynes thumps it straight to the cover-point fielder.
Around middle and leg, pushed towards mid off.
FOUR! Poor bowling this from Nida Dar. This is short and down the leg side, Rachael Haynes hangs back and just pulls it over backward square leg to collect another boundary.
Floated and around off, turning away slowly, Haynes leaves it alone.
FOUR! The boundaries are flowing at the moment and the 50 is up for Australia Women. On middle, Rachael Haynes gets in position quickly and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Again a bit short and close to off, Healy goes on the back foot and pushes it to extra cover. Two dots to end the over.
Flatter and a touch shorter on off, Healy defends it to the off side.
FOUR! And again! Tossed up, on off. Alyssa Healy dances down the track and this time goes over mid off to make it back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Alyssa Healy! This is flighted outside off, Healy gives the charge and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
This one slides on with the arm. Healy goes on the back foot and pushes it out on the off side.
On a length, around off and this is tapped towards point.

Another dropped catch! Nicely tossed up, on middle. Rachael Haynes tries to be aggressive as she steps out but can't quite get to the pitch of the ball. Haynes ends up hitting it uppishly to the right of the bowler. Nida Dar moves well on that side but just can't hold on to the catch.
Flighted, around off and Haynes pushes it towards mid off.
Tossed up, on middle. This is driven down to long on for one.

Now, was there any bat on it? It isn't given a wide, so that is another catch that is dropped. Around leg and drifting further. Rachael Haynes looks to tickle it really fine but gets a faint edge on it which goes through the gloves of Sidra Nawaz and they get a single down to fine leg.
This is dragged down on off, staying a bit low. Alyssa Healy goes deep in her crease to pull it down towards long on for a single.
Around off, played towards the cover region.
Nida Dar to bowl now.
A round-arm delivery, on off. Haynes pushes it towards mid off.

DROPPED! Difficult chance but Pakistan Women need to take these catches. This is dragged down on off, Alyssa Healy rocks back and pulls it hard but to the right of Aliya Riaz at mid-wicket. Riaz moves well to her right and gets both hands on the ball. She can't hold on though and that is a costly drop. Single taken.
Slowed up a bit, slanting in from around off. Healy moves leg side and works it towards covers.
On off, pushed down to mid off.
Quicker and flatter, fired into middle and leg. Healy defends it off the back foot.

Nicely tossed up, well outside off. Alyssa Healy's eyes lit up as she steps down the track and looks to go over covers. The shot is mistimed but Healy still picks up a couple of runs after clearing the infield.
Play and a miss! Short and outside off, angling away, Rachael Haynes flashes at it and misses. 13 from the over!
FOUR! Third boundary in the over and Australia Women are racing away! Yet another short ball, around off, Haynes swivels on the back foot and muscles it to deep square leg fence. All too easy.
FOUR! Whacked! Short and wide outside off, this is poor from Diana Baig, Rachael Haynes latches onto it and slaps it through point.
Caught off a Free Hit! A high full toss outside off, Haynes reaches out for it and lofts it off the toe end of the bat. It's caught at covers and Alyssa Healy cannot hide her glee.

FOUR! Bang! Short in length and around off, angling in, Rachael Haynes picks the length in a trice, immediately goes on the back foot and hammer-pulls it over mid-wicket. It's a no ball too for overstepping. Free Hit loading...
Offers width outside off, fuller in length, Haynes throws her hands at it and drills it through the line. But she fails to find the gap at covers.
Full and around off, shaping back in a bit, Haynes defends it near her front pad.
Very full and around off, Rachael Haynes drives it to the right of mid off and scoots to the other end. The fielder misses her shy at the bowler's end otherwise it could have been close.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Haynes jumps down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
Loopy and full, landing around off, Haynes gets forward and defends.
A touch short and around off, Alyssa goes on the back foot and strokes it through the gap at covers. Three runs taken.
Flatter and around off, defended from the back foot.
Uppish but safe! Full and flighted, wide outside off, Healy steps down the track and lofts it over covers. Doesn't middle it properly but clears the infield. Collects a couple.
Back of a length, around off, Haynes goes on the back foot and pats it down to point.
Angling in from around off, Rachael Haynes blocks it near her front pad.

FOUR! Elegance! Fuller in length, around off and angling away, Rachael Haynes leans forward, transfers her weight into the drive and pierces the gap at covers. Lovely timing and it races away to the fence.
Strides forward to a length ball and again pushes it with an angled bat to backward point.
Pitches it up and outside off, Haynes drives it with an angled bat and it goes on one bounce to the short backward point fielder.
Width on offer outside off, Haynes plays late and steers it wide of backward point for a couple of runs.
A hint of away turn as it lands around off, Alyssa Healy watchfully pushes it to point.
Flighted and around off, Alyssa Healy stays back and plays it with an angled bat to point.
Slower through the air, good loop, landing full and around off, it's driven to covers.
Tossed up, full and close to off, Healy is forward in defense.
Too full around off, Rachael Haynes drives it to the right of mid off and speeds away to the other end as the fielder fumbles slightly.
Full and flighted around off, Haynes drives it to mid off.
Spin straightaway as Anam Amin to operate from the opposite end.
Confusion over a run! Healy taps a length ball to the off side and sets off for a run. Rachael sends her back as Diana Baig rushes towards the ball to her left.
Slightly short and around off, from over the wicket, Healy goes on the back foot and taps it down on the off side.
Baig switches to 'round the wicket and serves it short around off, Haynes turns and pulls it to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Great timing! Back of a length, around off and angling away, Rachael Haynes buys the width, stands back and smacks it past backward point. The quick outfield does the rest.
Delivers it full and around leg, Rachael Haynes works it off her pads but finds square leg.
Baig begins with a short delivery around off, Alyssa Healy stands back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Australia Women are away!
